title: Case Study: EHR Healthcare — HIPAA, Legacy DB & Cloud Migration — D4
purpose: Shows identities, trust boundaries, policy checks, and audit evidence.
routing_rationale: EHR Healthcare mandates strict HIPAA compliance, continuous patient record synchronization from legacy on-premises hospitals, and sub-second querying of clinical histories with zero downtime.

groups.label: Google Cloud Healthcare API & DLP Tier

nodes.label: Epic / Cerner Hospital EMR
nodes.detail: Generates real-time patient admission, discharge, and transfer (ADT) messages.

nodes.label: Cloud Interconnect (Encrypted)
nodes.detail: Dedicated private hybrid connection with MACsec L2 wire-speed encryption.

nodes.label: Cloud Healthcare API
nodes.detail: Translates legacy HL7 messages into modern FHIR resources with BAA signed.

nodes.label: Cloud DLP De-Identification
nodes.detail: Pseudonymizes patient identifiers for clinical research pipelines.

nodes.label: Cloud Spanner EHR Multi-Region
nodes.detail: Stores core patient charts with continuous multi-region replication and CMEK.

nodes.label: BigQuery Analytics Lake
nodes.detail: Analyzes clinical efficacy and treatment outcomes without exposing patient PHI.

steps.title: Secure Ingestion & Standardization
steps.action: Hospital EMR streams HL7 messages over MACsec Interconnect into Cloud Healthcare API.
steps.why_traversal: Normalizes disparate legacy healthcare protocols into standardized FHIR format.

steps.title: Dual-Path Clinical Storage & Research
steps.action: Writes raw patient chart to Spanner while de-identifying data for research in BigQuery.
steps.why_traversal: Satisfies strict HIPAA patient privacy while enabling population health analytics.

scenarios.label: Unauthorized Direct Clinical Query Blocked
scenarios.root_cause: External analytics dashboard attempted to query raw patient charts directly from Cloud Spanner.
scenarios.diverted_path: VPC Service Controls denies request: analytics must query de-identified BigQuery lake.
scenarios.recovery: Re-point analytics tools to BigQuery de-identified dataset.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
